_status: DRAFT — authored by Sage, NOT confirmed by Ruby or any coach
_grounding: Proven live submissions from RivaFlow prod logs: ninja choke x3, armbar x2, bow-and-arrow, arm triangle, triangle, clock choke, RNC

Drilled material: De La Riva series (pulls, sweeps, kiss of the dragon, DLR->triangle), X-guard sweep, single-leg-X / outside ashi, inside ashi (saddle), cross to 50/50, footlock->kneebar, straight footlock, arm drags, knee slice, ankle pick, seated guard pulls
2026-07-15 purple-system report: A-game = top-game pressure smasher (knee cut / body lock -> pin -> arm triangle / kimura); B-game = half-guard knee-shield wrestle-up feeding back into A-game
AJJ BLUE syllabus base: double/single leg, arm drag -> rear clinch, osoto gari, body fold, sprawl -> guillotine / front headlock, punch block series, bridge and roll, elbow-knee escape, hip escapes
_tension_convention: Slots carrying a tension note have TWO defensible answers — his logged De La Riva / leg-entanglement game versus the report's pressure-pass archetype. Both are represented in the slate on purpose. The choice is Ruby's to confirm.
